children.value: > Fact From Story WeWork has filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection, listing over $18.6 billion of debt.
> > Fact From Story WeWork was a once high-flying startup co-founded by Adam Neumann and bankrolled by SoftBank, BlackRock and Goldman Sachs.
> > > Fact From Story WeWork’s stock hit a new low, dropping over 47% after hours to just $1.21, which brings the company’s market cap down to a mere $121 million.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge A company's stock dropping is a sign of financial trouble.
> > Commonsense Knowledge Filing for bankruptcy means the company has failed.
> Commonsense Knowledge Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection is something companies do when they are "going bust".
